title: Quiz Generator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Creates practice quizzes for any subject with answer keys. The Quiz Generator creates practice quizzes for any subject from course material. It writes multiple-choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, and short-answer questions, provides a complete answer key with explanations, and varies question difficulty from recall to application. Every question is tied to a specific part of the source material.
capabilities: Write multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer questions
Generate a full answer key with explanations
Vary difficulty from recall to application
Tie each question to its source material section
Shuffle questions and answers to prevent pattern memorizing
